vocab.example: I'm planning to upskill in cloud technologies over the next year.

lines.speaker: Hoa (interviewer)
lines.text: So, where do you see your career trajectory heading in the next 3 to 5 years?

lines.speaker: Minh (candidate)
lines.text: I'd like to move from a developer role into a technical lead position.

lines.speaker: Hoa (interviewer)
lines.text: That's a clear goal. How are you preparing to step up to a role like that?

lines.speaker: Minh (candidate)
lines.text: I'm trying to upskill in system design and mentoring junior developers.

lines.speaker: Hoa (interviewer)
lines.text: Good. Do you see yourself climbing the career ladder here at our company?

lines.speaker: Minh (candidate)
lines.text: Yes, I really do. I'd like to specialize in cloud architecture eventually.

lines.speaker: Hoa (interviewer)
lines.text: What's your biggest career aspiration beyond the next role?

lines.speaker: Minh (candidate)
lines.text: Long term, I want to expand my expertise and maybe lead a whole engineering team.

lines.speaker: Hoa (interviewer)
lines.text: That's ambitious. Why do you think this job is the right move for you?

lines.speaker: Minh (candidate)
lines.text: It feels like the next chapter I need to reach my goals.

lines.speaker: Hoa (interviewer)
lines.text: I appreciate your honesty. Is there anything holding you back right now?

lines.speaker: Minh (candidate)
lines.text: Not really, I just need the right opportunity, and I believe this is it.
